label: Spatiotemporality is a separate property: for some anchored esse classification and some spacetime…
paraphrase: Spatiotemporality is a separate property: for some anchored esse classification (the reasoner concrete, the set of 2 abstract) and some spacetime frame, each of the occupant, relational and part-of-spacetime senses is independent of concreteness: concrete-and-spatiotemporal, concrete-and-not, abstract-and-spatiotemporal and abstract-and-not all occur. It is a fact about the definitions, not a claim about which combinations are actual.
